title: Baku Baku Animal: Sekai Shiiku Gakari Senshuken
native_title: ばくばくアニマル ～世界飼育係選手権～
overview:
Aiming for the post of royal zookeeper, it's an eat-or-be-eaten uproar!!

Thanks for waiting!

Along with the popular "Arcade Mode", there is a new "League Match" that saves the records of matches between players, and a "Zookeeper Skill Exam" that judges the player's skill. Baku Baku Animal arrives on the Saturn in a new look!

王室おかかえ飼育係の座を目指し、食うか食われるかの大騒ぎ!!

おまたせ~!

人気の「アーケードモード」はもちろんのこと、プレイヤー同士の戦歴を保存できる「リーグ戦」や、プレイヤーの技量を判定する「飼育係技術者試験」を追加。装いも新たに「ばくばくアニマル」がサターンに登場!
